title: Profile cardio pages
summary: Profiles show the five latest cardio sessions at a time, with page controls for browsing older sessions.
changes: Your profile and shared profiles show five cardio sessions per page, newest first. Use the previous and next arrows or the page picker to browse older sessions, including sessions beyond the former latest-20 limit.
The Cardio header shows the visible range and total. Your selected page stays in place during profile updates, and a failed page request can be retried without losing the current page.

image.alt: Profile Cardio card with the five latest sessions, visible range and page controls, using synthetic sample data.
